shortDescription: Manage UCS Domain Profiles in Cisco Intersight

options.name: api_bearer_token
options.description: Bearer token for OAuth2 authentication with the Intersight API. When provided, I(api_key_id) and I(api_private_key) are not required and the C(cryptography) Python library is not needed. If not set, the value of the INTERSIGHT_API_BEARER_TOKEN environment variable is used.

options.name: api_key_id
options.description: Public API Key ID associated with the private key. If not set, the value of the INTERSIGHT_API_KEY_ID environment variable is used. Required if I(api_bearer_token) is not provided.

options.name: api_private_key
options.description: Filename (absolute path) or string of PEM formatted private key data to be used for Intersight API authentication. If a string is used, Ansible vault should be used to encrypt string data. Ex. ansible-vault encrypt_string --vault-id tme@/Users/dsoper/Documents/vault_password_file '-----BEGIN EC PRIVATE KEY-----     <your private key data>     -----END EC PRIVATE KEY-----' If not set, the value of the INTERSIGHT_API_PRIVATE_KEY environment variable is used. Required if I(api_bearer_token) is not

options.name: api_uri
options.description: URI used to access the Intersight API. If not set, the value of the INTERSIGHT_API_URI environment variable is used.

options.name: assigned_switch_a_serial
options.description: The serial number of the Fabric Interconnect to assign to SwitchProfile A. Resolved via the C(/network/ElementSummaries) API endpoint using the C(Serial) field.

options.name: assigned_switch_b_serial
options.description: The serial number of the Fabric Interconnect to assign to SwitchProfile B. Resolved via the C(/network/ElementSummaries) API endpoint using the C(Serial) field.

options.name: auditd_policy
options.description: Name of the Audit Log Policy to associate with both Fabric Interconnects.

options.name: certificate_management_policy
options.description: Name of the Certificate Management Policy to associate with both Fabric Interconnects.

options.name: description
options.description: The user-defined description of the UCS Domain Profile.

options.name: ldap_policy
options.description: Name of the LDAP Policy to associate with both Fabric Interconnects.

options.name: name
options.description: The name assigned to the UCS Domain Profile. The name must be between 1 and 64 alphanumeric characters, allowing special characters :-_. SwitchProfiles are automatically named C({name}-A) and C({name}-B).

options.name: network_connectivity_policy
options.description: Name of the Network Connectivity (DNS) Policy to associate with both Fabric Interconnects.

options.name: ntp_policy
options.description: Name of the NTP Policy to associate with both Fabric Interconnects.

options.name: organization
options.description: The name of the Organization this resource is assigned to. Profiles and Policies that are created within a Custom Organization are applicable only to devices in the same Organization.

options.name: port_policy_fi_a
options.description: Name of the Port Policy to associate with Fabric Interconnect A.

options.name: port_policy_fi_b
options.description: Name of the Port Policy to associate with Fabric Interconnect B.

options.name: snmp_policy
options.description: Name of the SNMP Policy to associate with both Fabric Interconnects.

options.name: state
options.description: If C(present), will verify the resource is present and will create if needed. If C(absent), will verify the resource is absent and will delete if needed.

options.name: switch_control_policy
options.description: Name of the Switch Control Policy to associate with both Fabric Interconnects.

options.name: syslog_policy
options.description: Name of the Syslog Policy to associate with both Fabric Interconnects.

options.name: system_qos_policy
options.description: Name of the System QoS Policy to associate with both Fabric Interconnects. This policy is mandatory for UCS Domain Profiles.

options.name: tags
options.description: List of tags in Key:<user-defined key> Value:<user-defined value> format.

options.name: use_proxy
options.description: If C(no), it will not use a proxy, even if one is defined in an environment variable on the target hosts.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Boolean control for verifying the api_uri TLS certificate

options.name: vlan_policy_fi_a
options.description: Name of the VLAN Policy to associate with Fabric Interconnect A.

options.name: vlan_policy_fi_b
options.description: Name of the VLAN Policy to associate with Fabric Interconnect B.

options.name: vsan_policy_fi_a
options.description: Name of the VSAN Policy to associate with Fabric Interconnect A.

options.name: vsan_policy_fi_b
options.description: Name of the VSAN Policy to associate with Fabric Interconnect B.
